Amazon Prime Day Apple Watch Deals Start at $199

Last updated: Oct 4, 2026 7:18 pm GMT-0700
By Paul Terpstra
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:49
Instaread

Amazon has launched early Apple Watch discounts for its October Prime Big Deal Days sale. Prices start at $199, while savings reach as much as $200 on selected models.

The promotion covers several generations of Apple’s smartwatch lineup. Therefore, shoppers can choose between an affordable SE model, newer Series 12 options and premium Ultra watches.

Apple Watch SE 3 Drops to $199

The lowest price applies to the 40mm Apple Watch SE 3 with GPS. Amazon lists the aluminum model with a Sport Band for $199, saving buyers $50.

Meanwhile, the larger 44mm SE 3 costs $229 after the same $50 discount. These deals make the SE 3 the most affordable option in the current promotion.

For shoppers who want newer hardware with cellular connectivity, Amazon has also discounted the Apple Watch Series 12.

The 42mm GPS + Cellular model costs $489.99 in either black or light gold aluminum. Both configurations receive a $10 discount. In addition, a 46mm space gray version with a navy blue Sport Band costs $539.99.

Apple Watch Ultra Models Get Bigger Savings

Amazon has also reduced prices on its premium Ultra lineup. The Apple Watch Ultra 4 now costs $779.99 in two listed configurations, saving buyers $20.

However, the strongest discount applies to the previous-generation Apple Watch Ultra 3. Amazon lists the black titanium model with a black Milanese Loop for $699.97. That price represents a substantial $200 saving.

As a result, buyers who do not need the latest Ultra model can secure the largest discount in the sale.

Prime Big Deal Days Offer Multiple Price Points

The promotion gives shoppers options across several budgets. The SE 3 provides the lowest entry price, while Series 12 models target buyers seeking newer features.

Meanwhile, the Ultra range remains aimed at customers who want Apple’s premium wearable. The source describes these offers as highlights from Amazon’s early Prime Big Deal Days sale, with additional Apple Watch discounts also available elsewhere.
